features.note: Thick, dark, arched brows with a clear angled peak, consistent with the references.
Light silver-grey almond eyes, same shape and tone as the references.
Long, straight, fairly narrow nose, though the tip reads slightly softer and wider in this lighting.
Full lips with a defined cupid's bow and the same closed-mouth half-smile.
Oval with a tapered chin, but the cheeks and jaw read slightly fuller and softer, with less cheekbone definition than in the references.
Long black curly hair well past the shoulders, slightly looser curls, which is acceptable.
Curvy hourglass figure: full bust, cinched waist under the tie belt, wide hips and full thighs. Not slimmed.

summary: Every feature matches Priya, but her skin is rendered noticeably darker and her face slightly fuller, so she reads as very likely her rather than unmistakably her; the frame itself is clean and fit to animate.
